name: Toaru Kagaku no Festival
original_name: とある科学の超輪姦祭
source:
This is a visual novel featuring characters from Toaru Kagaku no Railg**.
This product contains only the prologue and the first chapter.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE060924.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一部以《某科学的超电磁炮》角色为主角的视觉小说。
本产品只收录序章与第一章。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE060924.html]DLsite English[/url]）
